page.overview:
Who is Two-headed Brachiosaurus?

The Two-headed Brachiosaurus is a mutant Brachiosaurus that appears in as an embryo in a tank.

The Two-headed Brachiosaurus appeared in the InGen lab in a small container.

There was an image of the two-headed Brachiosaurus prop in the behind the scenes footage alongside with the other infant mutants in the small container.
